items.title: Tata Steel inches closer to buying controlling stake in APL Apollo as firms strike Rs 28,000-cr asset deal: Sources
items.description: Under the transactions announced, Tata Steel Colors is valued at Rs 16,300 crore Tata Steel’s tubes business is valued at Rs 11,700 crore.

items.title: SpiceJet crisis prompts pilots’ body to seek tighter financial surveillance of airlines
items.description: The pilots’ body has urged the government to strengthen oversight of airline finances, with SpiceJet’s deteriorating liquidity and operational disruptions highlighting gaps in early detection of financial stress

items.title: FSSAI approves prosecution against Bisleri after packaged water sample found 'unsafe'
items.description: According to the regulator, the laboratory findings established violations relating to unsafe food under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

items.title: Bloom raises $75m in latest funding round from Kedaara
items.description: Bloom focused early on tech, developing its proprietary cloud-based platform before onboarding the first hotel unit.

items.title: VinFast plans India e-scooter entry in 2027, eyes bigger share of EV market
items.description: VinFast also plans to introduce at least two car models in India every year and gradually increase production to the full annual capacity of 50,000 units at its Thoothukudi facility.

items.title: Airbnb looks beyond traditional holiday hubs to deepen India presence, bets on homestays
items.description: The company is looking to expand its reach beyond established leisure destinations such as Goa and hill stations, with growing interest in cultural, spiritual, nature-led and rural tourism.

items.title: Flipkart Wholesale cuts logistics costs by 6%, vehicle deployment by 8% with FarEye
items.description: The improvements have been achieved by digitising dispatch, routing, compliance and payment collection processes across 26 stores and one cross-dock, the companies said in a statement.

items.title: Imperial Blue sale pushes Pernod Ricard behind Diageo in India's alco-bev market
items.description: Pernod Ricard had retained the top position over the past couple of years after USL sold its popular mass-market whisky brands to Inbrew Beverages in 2021 as part of its strategy to premiumise its portfolio

items.title: ORN Ventures gears up for global travel business push with Rs 10,000 cr investment
items.description: In an interview with PTI, ORN Ventures Founder & CEO Vinay Gupta shared that the company is looking to deepen its presence in international markets as it scales its direct operator-to-consumer travel platform.

items.title: Maruti Suzuki hikes prices of select models from November 22, cites cost pressures
items.description: The increase comes as the automaker grapples with higher price pressures despite efforts to reduce costs
